categories.name: Advertising & Marketing
categories.description: Costs for promoting your business including online ads, print advertising, sponsorship, and marketing campaigns.

categories.name: Bank Charges & Interest
categories.description: Fees charged by banks and payment processors, including transaction fees, overdraft interest, and account maintenance charges.

categories.name: Car, Van & Travel
categories.description: Running costs for business vehicles including fuel, parking, tolls, MOT, and road tax. Excludes repairs (see Repairs & Maintenance) and purchase costs (see Motor Vehicle Expenses).

categories.name: Computer Equipment & Software
categories.description: Hardware purchases and software subscriptions used for business purposes, including computers, peripherals, SaaS tools, and hosting.

categories.name: Consulting & Professional Fees
categories.description: Fees paid to external professionals for advice and services including legal, accounting, tax, and specialist consultancy.

categories.name: Dues & Subscriptions
categories.description: Membership fees and subscriptions to professional bodies, trade associations, and business-related publications.

categories.name: Entertainment
categories.description: Costs of entertaining clients and business contacts. Note: business entertainment is generally not tax-deductible but should still be recorded.

categories.name: General Office Expenses
categories.description: General office equipment and supplies not covered by other categories, including furniture, fixtures, and miscellaneous office items.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.description: Business insurance premiums including professional indemnity, public liability, employers liability, and contents insurance.

categories.name: Light, Heat & Power
categories.description: Energy and utility costs for business premises including electricity, gas, and water bills.

categories.name: Meals & Subsistence
categories.description: Food and drink expenses incurred while travelling for business or working away from your normal place of work.

categories.name: Office Stationery & Supplies
categories.description: Consumable office stationery and supplies including paper, pens, ink cartridges, and other day-to-day office consumables.

categories.name: Postage & Courier
categories.description: Costs for sending mail and parcels including postage stamps, courier services, and shipping fees.

categories.name: Premises Costs / Rent
categories.description: Rent and associated costs for business premises including business rates, service charges, and coworking space fees.

categories.name: Printing & Reproduction
categories.description: Costs for printing, photocopying, and reproducing business materials including brochures, business cards, and signage.

categories.name: Repairs & Maintenance
categories.description: Costs for repairing and maintaining business premises and equipment, including plumbing, electrical, and general upkeep.

categories.name: Telephone & Internet
categories.description: Telephone and internet costs including mobile phone bills, broadband, landline charges, and VoIP services.

categories.name: Training & Development
categories.description: Costs for business-related training and professional development including courses, conferences, and certification exams.

categories.name: Travel & Accommodation
categories.description: Business travel costs including train fares, flights, taxis, and overnight accommodation when travelling for work.

categories.name: Use of Home as Office
categories.description: Proportion of household costs claimed for using part of your home as a business office, including a share of utilities, broadband, and council tax.

categories.name: Uniforms & Protective Clothing
categories.description: Costs for uniforms, branded workwear, and protective clothing required for business purposes.

categories.name: Cost of Goods Sold
categories.description: Direct costs of goods purchased for resale or raw materials used in manufacturing, including packaging and components.

categories.name: Subcontractor Costs
categories.description: Payments to subcontractors and freelancers for work performed on behalf of your business, including CIS-registered workers.

categories.name: Cleaning
categories.description: Costs for cleaning business premises including cleaning services, supplies, and waste disposal.

categories.name: Employee Costs
categories.description: Staff-related costs including salaries, wages, employer NI contributions, pension contributions, and statutory pay.

categories.name: Staff Welfare & Training
categories.description: Costs related to staff welfare and wellbeing including team events, employee benefits, health initiatives, and staff training.

categories.name: Bad Debts
categories.description: Amounts owed to your business that are unlikely to be recovered, written off as business expenses.

categories.name: Depreciation
categories.description: The reduction in value of business assets over time, calculated for accounting and tax purposes including capital allowances.

categories.name: Motor Vehicle Expenses
categories.description: Costs related to purchasing, leasing, and insuring motor vehicles used for business, plus major repairs and servicing.
